_source: Slice D23 snatch and interrogation: /mnt/project-files/plans/claude-api/CLAUDE_API_DRAFT.md §5.3 D (Kice 2026-11-18), Rotom mockup a7 as drawn in round 4 (plans/evil-mode-rework/mockups-v4/index.html #k7). Talk only, as in the games; never a Gym Leader, never anyone flagged a minor. Actions 58 Interrogate (the Snatch Operation) and 113 Hostage Trade, task 136 Hold a Prisoner, building 66 Interrogation Cell.

threat.label: Threat
threat.quick: Talk, or {boss} hears you sang anyway. Your choice.

bribe.label: Bribe
bribe.quick: There's ₽{cost} on the table, and it's yours the moment you remember something.

bluff.label: Bluff
bluff.quick: Your boss already sold you out. We know most of it; you just fill in the rest.

empathy.label: Empathy
empathy.quick: Nobody's coming for you. I am. Help me and you walk out of here tonight.

logic.label: Logic
logic.quick: Think it through. Your side won't miss you; you owe them nothing. Tell me and it's over.

info.label: {team} patrol · {district}
info.say: We walk {district} at nine and again at two. That's all I know!

info.label: {place} · the back way in
info.say: There's a loading door round the back of {place}. Nobody locks it.

info.label: {team} stash · {district}
info.say: Okay, okay! There's a stash in {district}. Take it, just let me go.

extortion.label: ₽{n} of {team}'s float
extortion.say: Here, it's the float for the week. They'll think I lost it.

extortion.label: His silence
extortion.say: I never saw you. I wasn't even in {district}.

extortion.label: {team} corner · {district}
extortion.say: Fine, the corner's yours. I'll tell them it got too hot.

info.label: {gym} rota
info.say: The Leader trains at six, before the doors open. Every day.

info.label: {leader}'s team
info.say: {leader} leads with the same one every time. Everyone knows. Well, now you do.

info.label: {place} · side door
info.say: The side door's code is the Gym's opening year. Don't tell them it was me.

extortion.label: ₽{n} prize money
extortion.say: Take my prize money. All of it. Just let me go.

extortion.label: Their silence
extortion.say: I'll say I took the night off. Nobody asks.

extortion.label: A favour at {gym}
extortion.say: I'll leave the side door open next week. Once.

info.label: {place} night patrol
info.say: F-fine! The guards change at the north lift at ten. Ten, not nine!

info.label: {district} security plan
info.say: Every site in {district} shares one guard roster. It's in my desk. Top drawer.

info.label: {payer} safe code
info.say: The safe code is my daughter's birthday. Take what's in it and go.

extortion.label: ₽{n} from {payer}
extortion.say: I can move ₽{n} tonight. Petty cash. It won't be missed.

extortion.label: His silence
extortion.say: No report. No police. I was home with a cold.

extortion.label: {place} handed over
extortion.say: The keys to {place}. They're yours. I'll sign whatever you want.

info.label: {team} patrols · {district}
info.say: Our patrols in {district} run on the hour. You'd have found out anyway.

info.label: {team} supply line
info.say: The supply run comes through {district} on Thursdays. There. Happy?

info.label: {boss}'s weak point
info.say: {boss} never leaves the office without the Persian. Never. Use that.

extortion.label: ₽{n} from {team}'s books
extortion.say: I can skim ₽{n} from the books. {boss} won't notice for a week.

extortion.label: {team} looks away
extortion.say: I'll tell {boss} you're not worth the trouble. For now.

extortion.label: {team} leaves {district}
extortion.say: We pull out of {district}. It was never worth much anyway.

lines.noCell: Build a Holding Cell first: nobody to keep them in.
lines.cellFull: The Holding Cell is full ({n}). Deal with who's in there first.
lines.nobody: Nobody here you'd take: never a Gym Leader, never a child.
lines.note: Snatch {name}, {title}: a battle first, then the questions.
lines.move: You move on {name} outside {place}. {cls} steps in to stop you.
lines.taken: {name} is bundled into the van and driven to the Holding Cell.
lines.lost: {name} got away and ran straight to the police. Heat +{n} in {district}.
lines.opened: Back to the Holding Cell: {name} looks up.
lines.start: I know my rights. I have nothing to say to you.
lines.replyBig: Okay! Okay. Just… stop. Ask me again.
lines.replySome: I— I can't tell you that. They'd know it was me.
lines.replyNone: That's it? I've had worse from my landlord.
lines.replyDig: You think that scares me? Now I'm not talking at all.
lines.broke: {name} has nothing left to hold back.
lines.noRoom: Questions first, then decide what to do with them.
lines.noGoal: Pick a Goal first: Info or Extortion.
lines.released: {name} walks out of the Holding Cell with a hood over their head. Heat +{n}.
lines.recruited: {name} joins the crew. They know where everything is now.
lines.refused: {name} won't join ({odds}%). You let them go. Heat +{n}.
lines.full: No room in the crew: {name} is released instead. Heat +{n}.
lines.nightHeat: A captive in the Holding Cell: Heat +{n}.
lines.escaped: {name} slipped out of the Holding Cell overnight and went to the police.
lines.found: Police searched the HQ and found {name} in the Holding Cell.
lines.foundEv: Officers found {name} held in the Holding Cell.
lines.noHostage: Nobody in the Holding Cell to trade.

interrogate.win: Nerve steady, you go to work.
